name: DRV8833
description: Dual H-bridge driver for DC motors, one bipolar stepper, solenoids, or other inductive loads. Each H-bridge delivers up to 1.5 A RMS / 2 A peak (at VM = 5 V, in the PWP/RTY packages) from a 2.7 to 10.8 V motor supply. Integrates N-channel power MOSFET bridges, PWM current regulation via external sense resistors, and protection including overcurrent, overtemperature, and undervoltage lockout reported on nFAULT. The 16-pin HTSSOP (PWP) has a PowerPAD for heat.

pins.name: nSLEEP
pins.description: Sleep mode input; logic high enables the device, logic low enters low-power sleep and resets logic (internal pulldown)

pins.name: AOUT1
pins.description: Bridge A output 1 (to motor winding A)

pins.name: AISEN
pins.description: Bridge A ground / current-sense; connect sense resistor to GND, or tie to GND if current control unused

pins.name: AOUT2
pins.description: Bridge A output 2 (to motor winding A)

pins.name: BOUT2
pins.description: Bridge B output 2 (to motor winding B)

pins.name: BISEN
pins.description: Bridge B ground / current-sense; connect sense resistor to GND, or tie to GND if current control unused

pins.name: BOUT1
pins.description: Bridge B output 1 (to motor winding B)

pins.name: nFAULT
pins.description: Open-drain fault output; pulled low on fault (overtemperature, overcurrent)

pins.name: BIN1
pins.description: Bridge B input 1; controls state of BOUT1 (internal pulldown)

pins.name: BIN2
pins.description: Bridge B input 2; controls state of BOUT2 (internal pulldown)

pins.name: VCP
pins.description: High-side gate-drive (charge pump) voltage; connect 0.01 uF X7R capacitor to VM

pins.name: VM
pins.description: Device/motor power supply (2.7 to 10.8 V); bypass with 10 uF (min) ceramic to GND

pins.name: GND
pins.description: Device ground; PowerPAD must also be connected to ground

pins.name: VINT
pins.description: Internal supply bypass; connect 2.2 uF, 6.3 V capacitor to GND

pins.name: AIN2
pins.description: Bridge A input 2; controls state of AOUT2 (internal pulldown)

pins.name: AIN1
pins.description: Bridge A input 1; controls state of AOUT1 (internal pulldown)

extra.current: 1.5 A RMS / 2 A peak per H-bridge (PWP)
extra.thermal_pad: exposed PowerPAD = GND, solder to ground plane

typical_application: Driving two small DC motors (or one low-voltage bipolar stepper) from a microcontroller with PWM speed and direction control.
gotchas: nSLEEP must be driven high to enable the device; it has an internal pulldown so it defaults to sleep
the HTSSOP exposed PowerPAD is GND and must be soldered to the ground plane for rated current/heat dissipation (tie it to pin 13)
set per-bridge current limit with external sense resistors on AISEN/BISEN; tie those pins to GND if current regulation is not needed
the two H-bridges can be paralleled (tie AIN/BIN and AOUT/BOUT together) to drive a single higher-current motor
motor supply range is only 2.7 to 10.8 V (abs max 11.8 V); it is a low-voltage driver, not for 12 V+ rails
nFAULT is open-drain and needs an external pull-up to read fault status
